title: Lost in a sea of individually shared Google Docs?
intro: Outline is the fast, modern, alternative to Google Docs built from the ground up for knowledge bases and wikis – on-premises or in the cloud.

features.title: Great looking docs, without the effort.
features.description: An intuitive editor built for the digital world instead of paper letters. With support for markdown, slash commands, and rich embeds.

features.title: Access control & permissions.
features.description: Manage access to your knowledge base with read & write permissions, user groups, guest users, public sharing, and more…

features.title: Structured & instantly searchable.
features.description: Nest documents in a hierachy, automatically build a rich network of backlinks and search across all the team's knowledge.

features.title: AI answers & built-in MCP.
features.description: Get instant answers from your knowledge base, or connect Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and other AI assistants to search, read, and edit docs with the built-in MCP server.

features.title: Cloud hosted or on-premises.
features.description: Outline is available as a cloud hosted service that's always up-to-date or as a self-hosted installation.

closing: Sign up with Google SSO in just a couple of clicks…
